name: Revitalize (Path of Iron)
body:
Design creation (healing); Level 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets up to one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You create a wave of revitalizing energy. Each targeted creature is cured 1d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +15). This script has no effect on constructs or undead.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, the healing increases by 1d8.
